summary: Production regression fix for 506: drops the two foreign keys 506 added from chart_of_accounts to account_funds (interfund_from_fund_id, interfund_to_fund_id). Three relationships between the tables made every unhinted PostgREST embed of account_funds from chart_of_accounts fail (financial statements, board portal budget, living budget, working forecast). Restores the single fund_id relationship. The interfund columns, the CHECK and the guard trigger stay; no row changes.

preflight.name: both 506 interfund foreign keys are present
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.chart_of_accounts'::regclass AND conname IN ('chart_of_accounts_interfund_from_fk', 'chart_of_accounts_interfund_to_fk')

preflight.name: the interfund guard trigger is present (it keeps validating the funds)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_chart_of_accounts_interfund_guard'

expected_changes: Updates the comments on chart_of_accounts.interfund_from_fund_id / interfund_to_fund_id.
No existing row in any table is changed; the interfund columns, the CHECK and the guard trigger remain.

verify.name: exactly one foreign key from chart_of_accounts to account_funds (fund_id)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE contype = 'f' AND conrelid = 'public.chart_of_accounts'::regclass AND confrelid = 'public.account_funds'::regclass

verify.name: the interfund CHECK and guard trigger remain
verify.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'chart_of_accounts_interfund_config_check') + (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_chart_of_accounts_interfund_guard'))::int
